issues.explanation: New controllers, routes, views, mail theme and translations ship with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, leaving happy-path, validation, user-enumeration and verification auth paths uncovered.
issues.location: tests/ (missing - no test files in change.diff)

conventions.evidence: Breeze-standard controllers with PHPDoc, inline $request->validate, guest/auth+signed+throttle routes, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry; deviation: zero tests despite conventions.md TDD rule 'No production code without a test'.

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:50-62, NewPasswordController.php:87-128, VerifyEmailController.php:50-61: small focused methods, clear names, Breeze-consistent style, no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:653-670 five named routes with guest and auth+signed+throttle:6,1; PasswordResetLinkController.php:165-167 always back()->with(status, passwords.sent); NewPasswordController.php:100-124 token/email/password min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers()+confirmed, Hash::make, remember_token rotation, PasswordReset event, redirect /; VerifyEmailController.php:50-61 EmailVerificationRequest + redirect /; config/mail.php:212-218 theme pegafila + pegafila.css:577-584 #0f7490 on .button-primary; lang/pt_BR.json Reset your password + Verify your email address; .env.example + phpunit.xml APP_NAME/LOCALE pins.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task/contract (locale pins, pegafila theme, 5 routes, 3 controllers, 2 views, 2 lang entries, User MustVerifyEmail); CHANGELOG entry is docs-sync; no login/Livewire/layouts/ui.php/Docker/SCSS changes.

security.evidence: guest group for reset, auth+signed+throttle:6,1 for verification; $request->validate on email/token/password; Hash::make + Str::random(60); EmailVerificationRequest enforces id/hash (403); {{ }} escaping + @csrf in both Blade views; always passwords.sent prevents enumeration.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password facade, PasswordRule, EmailVerificationRequest and default mail theme as base; no new actions/services/abstractions; full pegafila.css copy is the minimum required theme override.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or Test.php files; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for reset request/update, verification verify, pt-BR subjects, or theme.

review.summary: Delivers the full pt-BR password-reset guest flow, signed verification link, PegaFila mail theme and locale pins correctly and securely. Blocked from approval because it ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the project's test-first convention.
